synopsis: CEN, the European Committee for Standardization, and CENELEC publish EN standards, many adopting ISO texts, including EN ISO 16001:2017 [f15020]. The European Commission asks these organizations to develop standards specifying how to meet EU product-law requirements; standards whose references it publishes in the Official Journal are harmonized [f15077]. As of 1 October 2026, FprEN ISO 19014-1:2026 was in CEN approval, with European adoption proceeding alongside the 2026 ISO 19014 series changes; the supplied facts do not establish completed approval [f2211, f2317, f15179]. The booklet also lists CEN and CENELEC’s joint artificial-intelligence committee JTC 21 as not verified, leaving that organizational reference uncertain [f15022].
